product.title: Miami Biscayne Bay Jet Ski Tour
product.description: See the sights of Miami from the water during this Jet Ski tour along Biscayne Bay. Travel the waters of Biscayne Bay and enjoy the view of Miami’s breathtaking waterfront. See the sun-splashed downtown Miami skyline, the mansions of the rich and famous, the Venetian Islands, the Port of Miami, Miami Beach, and more. Along the way, look for dolphins, manta rays, sea turtles, manatees, and other ocean wildlife.
highlights: Enjoy a Jet Ski tour along Miami’s Biscayne Bay
Choose from multiple departure times throughout the day
Experience stunning waterfront views from your Jet Ski
Jet Ski rental and life jacket included

meetingPoint.name: Meeting point
meetingPoint.description: 3301 Rickenbacker Cswy, Key Biscayne, FL 33149, USA

itineraryItems.title: Biscayne Bay Jet Ski route
itineraryItems.description: Ride either toward Downtown Miami for skyline views or toward Miami Beach to see celebrity homes.

additionalInfo: Temporary boating license may be required and is not included
This activity ends back at the meeting point
